end_to_end.command: npm run build && npm run preview (Playwright-driven Chromium and WebKit at 1280x720 against http://localhost:4173)
end_to_end.expected: Stakes select lists $2 / $4 ... $20 / $40 with $4 / $8 selected and Buy-in $160 (20 big bets); choosing a stake updates Buy-in to 20 big bets; Cancel or Home resets to $4 / $8; Start game opens the table at the chosen stake with header Cash · 6 players · $s/$b · Hand #1, all stacks 20 big bets, seat 1 posts floor(s/2), seat 2 posts s; keyboard selection works; a hand can be played.
end_to_end.actual: Both browsers: for $2/$4, $3/$6, $6/$12, $20/$40 (and $10/$20 via the builder spec) the Buy-in text, header, 20bb stacks ($80/$120/$240/$800), blinds ($1/$2, $1/$3, $3/$6, $10/$20) and post-blind stacks all matched. Home and Cancel both reset to 4/8 with $160 buy-in. Clicking the label focuses the select; Tab reaches it; typeahead ('$1' -> $10 / $20, '$2' -> $20 / $40) changes the value and the Buy-in follows ($800); Tab to Start game + Enter opened the table at $20/$40. Arrow keys on a closed select open the native macOS popup (platform behaviour; value unchanged until chosen). Played a full hand at $20/$40: action labels Call $20 / Raise to $40 / Raise to $60 / Bet $20 / Bet $40, seat texts Small blind $10, Big blind $20, Raised to $40; 'Hand over' result shown. Screenshot: select 118x44 px, #f2f3f5 on #1a1d22, 15px system-ui, chevron visible, focus ring visible; layout fits 1280x720.
